items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: He had like 45 writers coming — Carole King, people like that.

ctx.x: ‘54. ‘54 and ‘55. And he became a very big publisher. He had like 45 writers coming — Carole King, people like that.
